Tiêu đề đề bài: Part 2 - Situation 1: Hosting a Foreign Friend during Exam Week
Nội dung chi tiết:
Situation: A close foreign friend is visiting your country for a week. However, you are extremely busy preparing for an important university final exam. You want to suggest the best option for your friend to explore the city:
- Joining a guided group tour (tham gia tour đoàn có hướng dẫn viên)
- Booking a private customized tour (đặt tour riêng theo yêu cầu)
- Exploring independently with a detailed itinerary (tự mình khám phá theo lịch trình gợi ý)

Which option do you think is the best choice and why?
